title: Administrative Decisions and the Right to Appeal
grammar: Verbs of legal remedy and compliance (fellebbez valami ellen, eleget tesz -nak/-nek, helyt ad)
goal: I can navigate the administrative appeals process from first-instance government offices to administrative courts.
I can use verbs governing postpositions (ellen, szemben) and datives (eleget tesz, helyt ad) in legal remedies.
I can explain judicial review (bírósági felülvizsgálat) and the grounds for nullifying an administrative resolution.
